title: Every command in the app's menus can be run by name from an agent
goal: Every command a person reaches from the menu bar and the right-click menus gets a stable name that an agent can list and run, with its arguments checked, and each run lands as one undo step exactly like a click. A test counts the commands and fails for any an agent cannot run, apart from a short written list left out on purpose. This is the second slice of the user's MCP ask.
notes:
Split out of claude-can-make-and-edit-pictures-and-videos-in (2026-10-19 manager pass). Meets the agent-api success list in queue/objectives.json.

Today (surveyed 2026-10-19): no registry. EditorCommands (EditorCommands.swift:73) is a SwiftUI Commands struct whose ~242 Buttons and 37 Toggles call EditorState through @FocusedValue(\.editorState) (:75); menus Capture :647, Image :671, Clip :1651, Sequence :1712, Video :1755, Layer :1889, Measure :2360, View :2420, plus CommandGroups. Timeline right-click: TimelineMenuThing / TimelineMenuRow (PhotonzCore/TimelineMenuTable.swift:18,44,68) with actions in EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift:155-220. Layer right-click: LayerCommandList.rows (LayerCommandMenu.swift:23); MenuRow is a closure (MenuRow.swift:65). Timeline keys: perform(timelineCommand:) (EditorState+TimelineKeys.swift:76). Menu actions target the focused editor; an agent call names its document instead.

If every menu cannot move in one sitting: land the table, the two tools and the coverage test with a not-yet list that may only shrink (a ratchet test), and file the remaining menus as one p1 task sequenced right behind this one.
acceptance: One table of the app's commands (name, menu title, area, arguments, when it is available) lives in PhotonzCore and is unit tested first; the menu bar, the timeline right-click rows and the layer right-click rows reach their actions through it, or the audit says why a row cannot
MCP tools list the commands (saying which can run right now on the named document) and run one; a run is one undo step, shown by a test and by one Command Z in the probe after an agent step
A coverage test lists every menu and right-click row and fails for each one with no command name, with an explicit left-out list giving the reason for each; the audit gives the count
The menus look and behave as before: the walks that drive them pass at Next defaults (the audit names them) and Scripts/test.sh passes

Try path: in Claude Code with the server, on a recording open in the probe, 'list the timeline commands, then cut the clip at 5 seconds'; one Command Z in the app puts it back. Transcript in the audit
Audit written under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
